alex: Quick heads-up  opening PR #4333 to standardize several tool-calling examples on the new envelope-shaped structured-output. Files touched: docs/examples/flows/order-cancel.md, docs/examples/flows/calendar-invite.md, docs/embeddings/quickstart.md, and docs/sdk/examples/embeddings.md. Need docs + SDK + link sweep.

rachel: Thanks. Can you add a tiny migration blurb too? PMs will want a one-paragraph note.

alex: Yep. Migration blurb will live in docs/migration/tool-calls.md (2-3 lines). Also adding the JSON Schema under docs/schemas/structured-output.json.

sam: I'll take calendar-invite. Will convert to use the envelope key: {"envelope": {"result": {...}, "meta": {...}}}.

kevin: For SDKs I'll add parse helpers (js + py) showing a regex fallback and then schema validation. Proposed JS helper for the docs:```js
// recoverJson: attempt parse, then try extracting first {...} block
function recoverJson(text) {
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) {
    const m = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
    return m ? JSON.parse(m[0]) : null;
  }
}
```

rachel: Include a short note: always validate parsed payload against the JSON Schema and surface a clear error to callers. Also include before/after fenced blocks for each snippet in the PR description (docs-bot will enforce).

maria: Embeddings sample is duplicated (quickstart + sdk examples). I'll update both and add a redirect from the old anchor used in the migration guide. I'll open a small redirects PR after this merges.

legal-bot: ATTENTION: The embeddings example references third-party code. Please add attribution comments and confirm license compatibility. Legal will ACK after attribution added.

kevin: For QA: propose two tiny smoke tests in docs-tests that render example LLM responses (snapshots) and assert schema validation passes. I'll add an AJV check for JS and a pytest for Python.

alex: Added checklist to PR description: (1) schema file; (2) examples updated; (3) SDK helpers; (4) tests added; (5) redirects to follow; (6) legal attribution.

sam: Ping me when CI preview is up and I'll start the review. Prioritize order-cancel first (customer-facing).

docs-bot: Reminder: docs style requires before/after diffs for migrated snippets. Missing diffs will block merge. Preview deploy will be created automatically for PRs that touch examples.

alex: Deploy preview will be attached to the PR. I'll also add the small migration blurb and a one-line compatibility note for older consumers that expect the flat shape.

rachel: After merge, let's publish a short note to #product-docs summarizing the change and where to find the migration steps. Keep it concise.

alex: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: Minor follow-up: include a tiny example of handling envelope errors (envelope.error) so integrators know how to fallback to a safe model.

alex: Good call. I'll add an error-handling snippet and a short example of fallback logic.

maria: I'll open the redirect PR and link it into #4333 once this lands.

docs-bot: Deployed preview (once ready) will be at https://deploy-preview-4333--docs.redwood.ai/tooling/structured-output (expires in 48h).

alex: Thanks everyone, pushing the branch now. Leaving thread open for follow-ups.
